name: The ER Nurse Coloring Book
seoTitle: ER Nurse Coloring Book with Funny Quotes
metaDescription: An adult coloring book for ER nurses with patterns and funny quotes. A budget friendly way to help an emergency nurse unwind after a wild shift.
summary: A coloring book made for ER nurses, mixing relaxing patterns with jokes only an emergency department crowd will fully appreciate.
whyItWorks: Emergency department shifts are loud, unpredictable, and full of stories nobody outside the ER would believe. Coming home and switching off is hard. Coloring is a low effort way to quiet the brain, and a book with ER themed humor makes it feel like it was made for them rather than grabbed from a generic shelf.

The funny quotes are part of the appeal. Dark humor is how a lot of ER staff cope, and a gift that gets the joke tells them you understand their world a little. It is budget friendly, so it works for Secret Santa, a unit gift exchange, or a small present for a friend who just finished a brutal week. Add a pack of colored pencils or fine tip markers so it is ready to use the moment they open it. It also makes a nice addition to a break room shelf, where tired coworkers can grab a page during a rare quiet moment and share a laugh.
goodToKnow: Pencils or markers are not mentioned in the title, so plan to add your own.
The humor is aimed at ER nurses, so it lands best with emergency staff.
Check the listing preview pages to see the style of designs and quotes.

faq.q: Is this only for ER nurses?
faq.a: It is written for them, so ER nurses will get the most out of the jokes. Nurses from other units may still enjoy the patterns.

faq.q: Does it come with colored pencils?
faq.a: The title does not say so. Pair it with a set of pencils or markers to make it a complete gift.
